steps.title: Inspect Existing Code and Fix Import Typo
steps.description: Review the existing MainActivity code and correct the malformed JSON import syntax to restore proper compilation.

steps.title: Add Voice Status Banner to Layout
steps.description: Integrate a sweet, stylish real-time voice chat banner in activity_main.xml to clearly signal to the user when Continuous Voice Chat is active.

steps.title: Initialize TextToSpeech with Progress Tracking
steps.description: Implement an UtteranceProgressListener inside TextToSpeech to detect when Priya finishes speaking her response, which is crucial for real-time continuous voice chat.

steps.title: Configure Continuous Voice Loop
steps.description: Build the automatic response-to-listening loop. When Priya finishes talking, the microphone turns back on automatically without requiring button taps.

steps.title: Enhance Speech Recognition Actions
steps.description: Configure SpeechRecognizer callbacks so that in Continuous Voice Mode, transcribed messages are automatically queued to Gemini for rapid dialogue.

steps.title: Implement Double-Send Safeguards for Cancel Timer
steps.description: Enhance the 3-second cancel queue to automatically send any pending messages if a user immediately schedules a new message, preventing queue collisions.

steps.title: Upgrade AI Response Typing Animation
steps.description: Establish a dynamic UI cycle of dots directly inside the active list view model indicating that Priya is actively formulating thoughts in real time.

steps.title: Customize Typing Bubble Visuals in Adapter
steps.description: Refine ChatAdapter styling logic to display the typing animation bubble in a distinct, cute pink-shaded background.

steps.title: Incorporate Audio Toggle Status Management
steps.description: Synchronize the voice toggle button, state, status banner, and shared preference storage to ensure the user stays fully informed of the app's audio mode.

steps.title: Verify Resource Cleanups and Lifecycles
steps.description: Guarantee that TTS voice output, SpeechRecognizer listening states, and post-handlers are securely destroyed on close events to eliminate memory leaks.

steps.title: Building PriyaAi Girlfriend
steps.description: Compile the app with the newly implemented real-time voice capabilities and animation visual styles.
